residual_assessment.precise_problem: How far can predeclared nonreport equality/difference contrasts identify a familiar-mineness bridge without outcome-selected labels?
residual_assessment.net_increment_after_subtraction: An exact UCT-specific constraint ladder from 65,536 bridges to one complementary pair, and a four-part separation of compression, polarity, semantic naming and actual measurement; no claim of new parity-graph mathematics or first no-report method.

residual_assessment.reusable_knowledge: Name-free contrasts can identify an unoriented organizational partition. A complement-symmetric evidence class cannot choose its positive experiential pole; marker orientation needs an independent bridge.
residual_assessment.evidence_and_limits: Exhaustive 65,536-bridge enumeration; signed-constraint component proof; reversed-marker and adaptive-reflex counterexamples; primary no-report design comparison; full v1.1.2 map traversal. No actual instance, valid B_fam anchor, reviewer closure or worldwide priority.
residual_assessment.next_specific_action: Predeclare a cross-population or interventionally reversed-marker polarity anchor and test whether its phenomenal interpretation is independent of report and of the marker chosen to measure it.
